grading_notes: 21 fields are not value-graded by the harness. It ships 9 canonicalization rules and none of them turns Y/N into a boolean, a CSV string into an array, or a 'DD-MON-YY' string into a date. Adding rules to the harness is forbidden (mongo-recon-harness SKILL.md), so the three missing rules are raised as profile feedback in canonicalization.json and every affected field is graded instead by a Tier 4 parity op under the ops directory. The fields stay in this spec under fields_ungraded_pending_profile_rule, so the implementation contract for the children is unchanged. Separately, every field decoded through CODES sits under fields_decoded_graded_by_op: the source holds an integer and the target holds the decoded string, so no canonicalization rule can compare them. Each is graded by a Tier 4 parity op that decodes on the SQL side and groups on the Mongo side.
